title: UCSF-PDGM / BraTS 2021 patient-overlap audit: code and derived metadata
description: Identifier-level audit of UCSF-PDGM v5 against BraTS 2021 (patient-level linkage, follow-up scans, cohort composition) and notebooks for the exploratory stratified segmentation analysis. Companion to the paper 'Hidden Patient Overlap Between Public Glioma MRI Cohorts'.
